decision.reason: [ev-589a6c291015] only says that settings were "added" to "stabilize gateways for high traffic". It does not name any setting, key, Helm value or field, and it gives no before/after value, scope or default behaviour. So no one can write the subject, change, applicability or consequence. The note is also mistyped ("stabilizew"), and the PR or gateway values change it refers to (note 53121) is needed to identify the concrete settings.
